preferences.preference: Warm, sophisticated, and residential; strictly avoid generic corporate or clinical atmospheres.
preferences.guidance: Select venues with architectural character, soft ambient lighting (2700K), and curated acoustic environments.

preferences.preference: 100% dietary inclusivity with parity of presentation; dedicated craft zero-proof cocktail pairings.
preferences.guidance: Never treat non-drinkers or dietary restrictions (vegan, celiac, nut-free) as an afterthought.

preferences.preference: Zero budget variance tolerance; minimum 10% contingency buffer reserved until 48 hours prior to event.
preferences.guidance: Require explicit two-phase human sign-off on any line-item modifications exceeding 5% of total budget.

preferences.preference: Private or fully sequestered spaces; conversation noise floor must allow unamplified speech without vocal strain.
preferences.guidance: Inspect venue background music policy, kitchen pass noise, and adjacent dining partitions.

preferences.preference: Facilitated organic connection; structured conversation prompts over open unstructured mingling.
preferences.guidance: Incorporate thoughtful icebreakers, intimate seating pods (maximum 6-8 guests per table), and personal arrival greetings.
